name: Four-parameter polynomial family
definition: A set of fourth order polynomials with parameter 'a'. The Catmull-Rom spline is the subset where a=0. When a=-1/2, the second derivative is continuous.
summary: The four-parameter polynomial family is a set of fourth-order reconstruction filters that generalizes Catmull-Rom splines, offering second-derivative continuity unachievable with cubic splines.
